advancements.exotic_worlds.circumnavigat: Travel a full lap around the world
argument.exotic_worlds.pos.outside_world: %s is outside this world — it must be between %s and %s
commands.exotic_worlds.region.across_sea: That area crosses the world seam and could mean either side of it — run the command once per side
message.exotic_worlds.schematic.selectio: That selection is wider than the world and would cover some blocks twice — place the second corner closer to the first
Growing that selection would make it wider than the world and cover some blocks twice — scroll the other way
message.exotic_worlds.create.structure_c: That structure goes all the way around the world, so it cannot move as one contraption — leave a gap in it
gui.exotic_worlds.world_shape.normal.hin: The vanilla world: an endless plane in every direction.
gui.exotic_worlds.world_shape.toroidal.h: Both horizontal axes loop — walk far enough in any direction and you return to where you started.
gui.exotic_worlds.world_shape.cylinder.h: One horizontal axis loops, the other goes on forever like vanilla.
gui.exotic_worlds.world_shape.seam_warni: This world type brings a world generator of its own: a World Shape still bounds and loops the world, but the terrain will not line up at the seam.
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.cons: Smaller than the village grid — structures will be scarce.
Room for villages; woodland mansions will be rare.
Room for all common structures; strongholds sit closer than usual.
Room for every structure at its usual distance.
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.size: World size along X in chunks (%s–%s)
World size along Z in chunks (%s–%s)
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.hint: How far you walk before you arrive back where you started.
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.neth: How much shorter the same journey is through the Nether. Only scales that divide the world evenly are offered.
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.end_: The End wraps at its own width, untied to the world size. Smaller than the minimum would leave no outer islands — no end cities, no elytra.
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.clim: Biomes keep their usual size, so a small world may be all forest or all desert.
Shrinks biomes just enough for one full climate to fit into a lap; on a world already wide enough it changes nothing.
Shrinks biomes four times over, and more where fitting the climate needs more — never less than Auto.
Shrinks biomes exactly as many times as you type below.
Coastlines and terrain keep their usual size.

How many times smaller biomes get: temperature's value at the chosen size, and vegetation takes its own. A 1 means this mode changes nothing at this size — the climate already fits. Editable in Custom alone, as a whole number from 1 to 64.
gui.exotic_worlds.toroidal_settings.guar: Keeps a world from coming out all ocean: where a lap would leave nowhere to stand, the land level rises just enough for one island. A world that already has land is left as it is.
Makes the Nether hold at least one nether fortress and one bastion remnant, each in a biome it can stand in. Without it a small Nether often has neither.
gui.exotic_worlds.cylinder_settings.axis: The world loops along this axis and goes on forever along the other.
gui.exotic_worlds.settings.title: Exotic Worlds Settings
gui.exotic_worlds.settings.map_copies_hi: How map mods show a looped world full screen: Repeated fills the window with its copies, Single shows the world once and stops panning and zooming out at its edges. Minimaps always repeat it.
